description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
